name: openai-to-mistral-transformer
description: Adapts OpenAI Chat Completions requests for Mistral-compatible upstreams by pinning the model, stripping OpenAI fields Mistral rejects, and rewriting the request path. Mistral already emits OpenAI-shaped responses, so responses are normalised and passed back in OpenAI shape. Supports both routed (multi-provider) and unconditional (single-provider) execution modes.
